name: Tyria Realism
status: Experimental preview; individual components tested, full new-install matrix incomplete
description: A reversible graphics toolkit for Guild Wars 2: SDR/ReShade looks, an optional experimental AMD neural path and documented compatibility.

tested.environment: Windows 11 Pro; Ryzen 7 5800X; DX11; 2560x1440 SDR; driver 32.0.32015.2008
tested.result: Real GW2 inference observed. Improvement is scene dependent and was often subtle; it is not a texture overhaul.
116 shaders compile; game shader replacements and world-only grading demonstrated. Experimental source patch; no ready-made binary bundled.
Both loaded and more than 500 neural frames completed. Joint GW2 quality, motion stability and AFMF acceptance remain incomplete.

tested.environment: Separate earlier GW2 DX11 runs, native and earlier Tyria setup
tested.result: AMD AFMF frames detected. An AMD Software UI restart resolved one inactive status. Latest look/combined stack has no full AFMF validation.

tested.environment: Four shaders in a separate DX11 harness; user screenshots from GW2
tested.result: Runtime shader compilation passed. New Balanced/Quality look has no controlled GW2 FPS or full depth/HUD acceptance yet.

tested.environment: Isolated folders and current source build
tested.result: 23 native self-checks passed; tested archive/hash/signature validation and rejection of corrupt dependency archives. This is not a fresh end-to-end test of every new release option.

compatibility.neural: Not supported by this AMD backend; no alternative implemented
No support claim for this Windows package

limits: No native NVIDIA DLSS 5 integration, DLSS Super Resolution or FSR4 is implemented.
No new GW2 texture pack, ray tracing, geometry or BRDF replacement is included.
Engine motion vectors are not proven. The latest combination test used neutral motion/depth guides; camera-motion artifacts need testing.
REST is not included or validated with the RenoDX experiment. Global effects may modify the HUD.
Do not combine multiple bloom, AO or sharpening stacks without a controlled comparison.
No ArenaNet endorsement or account/anti-cheat approval is claimed. Use is at the player's discretion.
